name: Silathoranam
distance: 1 km from main temple (near Chakra Teertham)
description: 2.5-billion-year-old natural pre-Cambrian geological rock arch formation; classified as a national geo-heritage monument.

name: Srivari Padaalu
description: The highest peak on Tirumala hills where Lord Venkateswara first set His divine footprints on Earth.

name: Japali Hanuman Theertham
description: Ancient swayambhu forest temple where Sage Jabali performed penance and Lord Hanuman resides.

name: Akasa Ganga Waterfall
description: Sacred mountain waterfall providing holy water for the Lord's daily Abhishekam ritual.

name: Papavinasanam Reservoir & Theertham
description: Holy bathing waterfall and reservoir surrounded by scenic hills, believed to wash away sins.

name: Sri Venkateswara Museum (SV Museum)
description: Houses ancient stone sculptures, bronze idols, temple armor, musical instruments, and photo archives.

name: Chandragiri Fort & Raja Mahal
distance: 12 km from Tirupati / 28 km from Tirumala
description: 11th-century Vijayanagara kingdom capital palace with light and sound shows.

name: Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park
distance: 20 km from Tirumala hilltop / 10 km from Tirupati station
description: One of Asia's largest natural zoos spread over 5,500 acres within the Seshachalam forest biosphere.

name: Talakona Waterfalls
description: Highest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh (270 ft cascade) located in dense forest with canopy rope walk ways.
